description: Row position in the official UCI file (data/breast-cancer-wisconsin.data). Use it to trace any result back to the source.
Sample code number. Identifies a sample record; it does not by itself establish that two rows are the same person.
Clump thickness of cells in a fine-needle aspirate of a breast mass. Scored 1-10 by an examiner; higher values are more abnormal.
Bare nuclei. Scored 1-10. Empty where the official file has '?' (16 rows).
Class as coded by UCI: 2 = benign; 4 = malignant.
Collection group reconstructed from row position using section 4 of breast-cancer-wisconsin.names. NOT recorded in the source data; treat as an assumption.
Month the collection group arrived, per section 4 of breast-cancer-wisconsin.names. Same caveat as collection_group_derived.
